prompt: The prototype in shop-agent/ is ready for our cluster. Add Kubernetes deployment with Postgres persistence and Argo CD delivery; images go to ghcr.io/acme. Keep the agent code and the eval data exactly as they are.

checks.expr: get(data, 'create_params.deployment_target') == 'kubernetes' and get(data, 'create_params.checkpointer') == 'postgres' and get(data, 'create_params.cd') == 'argocd' and get(data, 'create_params.registry') == 'ghcr.io/acme'

checks.why: enhance renders the chart; editing the manifest by hand does not

reference: From shop-agent/: `graph-agents-cli scaffold enhance . --deployment-target kubernetes --checkpointer postgres --registry ghcr.io/acme --cd argocd -y` (3-way merge; agent code, datasets and config are never touched), then check with `graph-agents-cli info` / `lint`.
